GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se.

   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash
